review_description: The Team At HV Solar provided quality advice and info from the get get. Worked with us to design a system that meets current and future requirements. Quality service and quality products. Would recommend

Joel was very professional and quick to respond to the many questions I had.  I did a lot of research before picking my solar installer, and at the end of the day HV Solar were a clear first choice.  They also did a great job with the system and left the yard spotless.  Then organised the grid connection after the install.  Very, very highly recommended.

How was the sales/quoting process?:Joel from HV Solar made the whole process easy and straight forward. After we contacted their team, he organised a site visit within a few days and provided four separate honest quotes that came in lower than every other one we received. Most importantly, he didn't try to upsell us with an oversized system we didn't need, like a few others tried to do.How did the installation go?:After excepting our preferred system, he booked us in for our install within the week.And because you know, its 2020, there was an issue with receiving some of our Solaredge components from Melbourne. But Joel was honest, kept us up to date and sent his team over to install all the racking and wiring until the rest of the components arrived. But 2020 wasn't finished and the rain set in. Again we were kept in the loop and the team was sent over as soon as there was a break in the weather to complete the install.The boys that did the install were punctual, polite and took all their rubbish with them.All the paper work for grid connection was submitted on the day of install and Energy Australia contacted us the next day for meter recalibration and plan selection. They actually mentioned that all the paperwork had been submitted rather quickly from their experience.All in all we're more than happy with how Joel and the team handled the whole process from start to finish and would without doubt recommend the HV Solar Team.And most importantly our system looks awesome and is already generating more than quoted, even on these cloudy days!

Fantastic quote with thoughts given to other options not thought of. Was given quotes for different size systems. Installation was done efficiently and clean. Given a run through of the Solaredge app and how to monitor the system, how to handle misfunctions.Very Happy

We decided to use a local installer who gave us very valuable information and was extremely easy to work with and very efficient. The installation went extremely well even though the installers were working in very hot conditions. They were very polite and friendly, punctual and took all the rubbish with them. Customer service was excellent and I would not hesitate in recommending HV Solar.

If you are looking at getting Solar call Joel from HV SOLAR, he was great, great knowledge of systems and batteries.Was not pushie like salesmen are it is only himself and his apprentice Which allows him to quote a much better price then any of the bigger companies.Would highly recommend
